method: Human review of eight frames per clip at 2 fps, supplemented by decoder and browser playback checks

notes.visible: Supervisor raises a spirit level and holds it vertically against the accessible timber wall element beside a two-storey building.
notes.limits: Bubble reading, structural capacity, hidden connections and code compliance are not established. Plans, a separate access inspection and written checkpoint record are not shown.

notes.visible: Two gloved hands lower a cylindrical metal component onto the fixture and then release or pause around it.
notes.limits: Whether the intended fixture seat is correctly engaged is uncertain from this view. No tolerance reading, part identifier, calibration check, release decision or separate parking event is established.

notes.visible: Gloved hand moves a practice instrument toward coloured artificial targets in a tray or trainer-like setting; movement pauses near a target.
notes.limits: Instrument geometry is generated and must not be treated as a faithful model of a real laparoscopic tool. Contact is ambiguous, and a clear withdrawal is not shown. The requested approach-pause-withdrawal sequence is incomplete; withdrawal and final-after-withdrawal steps remain unobserved. Context and instrument suitability need instructor confirmation.

notes.visible: Foreground dancer takes a short lateral/diagonal step and changes facing direction, ending in a pause. A mirror reflection is visible behind the foreground performer.
notes.limits: Track the foreground dancer only. Do not count the reflection as another participant or repetition. A return to the initial spot is not clearly shown, and the exact coach cue and quarter-turn angle cannot be established.

notes.visible: Athlete begins upright, lowers, briefly occupies a lower position, and rises to upright; the body and feet remain visible.
notes.limits: Only one visible cycle is represented. Do not infer pain, loading symmetry, precise joint angles, readiness or ideal technique; the lowered position is not a prescribed depth target.
